name: Uber Visa Card

apr.notes: Variable APR based on creditworthiness. No annual fee.

base_rate.description: Earn 1% back on all other purchases.

categories.label: 4% back on dining, restaurants, bars, and Uber Eats
3% back on travel including hotels, airlines, and Uber rides

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem cash back for Uber credits, gift cards, or statement credits.

signup_bonus.description: Earn $100 off Uber after spending $500 on purchases in the first 90 days.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: You're not responsible for unauthorized charges.

benefits.title: Free Online FICO Credit Score Access
benefits.description: Free online access to your FICO Credit Score.

benefits.title: Mobile Phone Insurance
benefits.description: Cell phone protection coverage for damage or theft when you pay your mobile phone bill with your card.

notes: Discontinued October 2021. Cardholders product-changed to Barclays View Mastercard. The Uber Visa was a no-annual-fee Visa Signature card earning 4% back on dining/Uber Eats, 3% on travel/Uber rides, 2% on online purchases, 1% elsewhere. No foreign transaction fees. Verified from Wayback Machine snapshot of the official Barclays product page (Aug 2020).
